params.prompt: In-game screenshot of a polished stylized 3D action-adventure game set in Hyehwa-dong, Seoul, Korea, inside a small real-life interior. SETTING: the same tiny home at night. The round low dining table is folded and leaning on the wall; two thin futon mattresses are laid on the warm yellow vinyl floor over the electric heating mat; the child's study desk with a warm desk lamp switched on is the main light, plus one ceiling light turned off; the clothes hanger rack, the small kitchenette in shadow, the framed helmet photo and the hammer on the wall catching the lamp light; the window shows a dark indigo sky with the floodlit fortress wall. The ten-year-old girl in pajamas sleeps under a blanket; the player character in a grey hoodie sits on the floor against the wall writing in a small notebook by the lamp. Warm orange lamp pool against cool blue moonlight from the window. RENDERING STYLE: cel-shaded 3D that reads like a flat-colored anime background painting. Every surface is a flat color area with exactly one crisp shadow tone (a warm grey multiply of the base color, never black or muddy), thin warm-black ink outlines (#1A1417) on silhouettes, frames, furniture and object edges; outlines get thinner with distance. No gradients on walls, no photographic textures, no realistic dirt: materials are suggested only by sparse hand-drawn marks (a few ink dots, short hatching strokes, tile seams, wood grain lines). Muted low-saturation palette, subtle paper grain over the whole image, gentle split toning. Shapes are clean and readable like a real-time 3D game built from modular pieces, yet rich in lived-in props. CAMERA: third-person game camera, lens height about 1.6 m, 35 mm lens, natural eye-level perspective, the whole room readable. The reference image shows the player character (a lanky 17-year-old Korean boy with curly black hair): draw him small, standing in the lower left third and filling about one third of the image height. No HUD, no UI, no watermark. Posters, boards, menus and labels are simple blocks of color or tiny illegible scribbles: absolutely no readable letters, no Korean or English text, no numbers, no logos, no brand marks anywhere. No alcohol, no cigarettes.
